name: P11_owner_assistant
role: System message of the owner assistant (n8n AI Agent node): read the owner's listings, turn a request such as "the rent is now 400" or "remove photo 2" into a proposed change with the propose_change tool, and say in one or two sentences what is proposed. Nothing is written until the owner confirms; the change and its checks are in code and in the database (D-088).
